title: Vanilla Meals
description: Adds Vanilla Like Meals To Minecraft
body:
# **Vanilla Meals**


The Vanilla Meals Mod adds over 30+ food items to Minecraft. A good mix of drinks and meals that are useful for different stages of the game.

## **Modpacks**
Yes, it's perfectly find for you to use this mod in a modpack.

## **Support**
If you enjoy the mod and would like to support the project, feel free to [leave a donation on my Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/mier78). Support is greatly appreciated!

## **Features**
- Adds 39 edible food items
  - Bread Slice
  - Buttered Bread Slice
  - Toast
  - Buttered Toast
  - Burnt Toast
  - Buttered Burnt Toast
  - Cheese
  - Butter
  - Raw Egg
  - Cooked Egg
  - Hard Boiled Egg
  - Hard Boiled Turtle Egg
  - Hard Boiled Sniffer Egg
  - Grilled Cheese Sandwich
  - Cooked Mushroom
  - Loaded Baked Potato
  - Chicken Stew
  - Beef Stew
  - Spider Eye Stew
  - Fish Stew
  - Raw Bagel
  - Raw Egg Bagel
  - Bagel
  - Egg Bagel
  - Egg And Cheese Bagel
  - Egg And Cheese Egg Bagel
  - Beef And Cheese Bagel
  - Beef And Cheese Egg Bagel
  - Carrot Juice
  - Kelp Juice
  - Melon Juice
  - Glistering Melon Juice
  - Sweet Berry Juice
  - Glow Berry Juice
  - Apple Juice
  - Chorus Juice
  - Cup Of Milk
  - Cocoa Milk
  - Cup Of Water

## 
- Adds 5 items for crafting meals
  - Juicer
  - Milk Stack
  - Water Stack
  - Cup
  - Dough
